Every file declares the playwright stdio MCP server with the template args (--headless --isolated --executable-path=/usr/local/bin/chromium --no-sandbox). Only scored/functional/judge.toml:14-18 declares the verifier server: command /usr/local/bin/python3, args ["/tests/tools/restart_mcp.py", "$APP_RESTART_HELPER"]; test.sh:193 exports APP_RESTART_HELPER="$LOG_DIR/app-restart.sh" before the suites (test.sh:213,224), generated by heredoc+sed and chmod 755 (127-191) with the .used marker cleared (192); test.sh, restart_mcp.py, score.py and tests/Dockerfile are diff-identical to the frozen template. Aggregation: gates all_pass, scored weighted_mean. Criteria: render 1 (hro_gate_render, binary, w1), constraints 1 (hro_gate_shared, binary, w1) - gates binary; functional 12 binary, unique ids, weights 4.5/7/4/5.5/5/7/4/4.5/6/5.5/3.5/4.5 sum 61 (matches the judge.toml:23 comment '61 in all'); polish 5 binary unique, weights 2/2/2/1.5/2; visual 5 likert points=5 w1 each with anchors. All weights positive, descriptions non-empty. Prompts resolve: every prompt.md exists, contains {criteria} (runner.py requires it) and {app_context} (substituted by test.sh:195-201 from tests/app_context.md), opens http://localhost:3000. Restart usage: only hro_intake_restart (first functional criterion) calls restart_app; functional prompt line 1 says 'Use restart_app only if your criterion says so, and then only once'; restart_mcp.py marker enforces single use. Deviation from template: functional uses mode="individual", timeout=700 (template batched, 9000). RewardKit 0.1.7 (pinned harbor-rewardkit==0.1.7) accepts JudgeMode Literal['batched','individual']; arun_agent registers MCP servers once then _arun_agent_individual runs each criterion sequentially with the same prompt template and per-call timeout, so the wiring is structurally valid and the single-use restart lands in exactly one session. Budget nesting holds on source: gates 600+600 < 1500; scored 12x700 + 900 + 900 = 10200 < 11100 (--max-concurrent-agent 1); 1500+11100 < 13200. Lessons check: lesson 10 assembled prompt sizes are small (functional ~8.6 KB prompt + 1.9 KB context + one criterion <=2.6 KB per individual session; polish ~7.0+1.9+~5 KB; far under 128 KB); lesson 6 checker-not-fixer line present in all five prompts (line 7); lesson 9 step-report/skipped-step-fails line present in scored prompts; lesson 4 gates are single simple binary criteria. Counterexample attempts: a dead app that never persists cannot pass hro_intake_restart because a failed/unavailable restart_app scores 0; a conforming app cannot be blocked by restart exhaustion because no other criterion calls restart_app. Residual risk (why risk=true): the raw-evidence index states no full configured grading run exists, so the non-template individual-mode functional wiring, the $APP_RESTART_HELPER expansion and the per-criterion 700 s cap have not been exercised end-to-end by RewardKit; a criterion that times out is silently scored 0 by RewardKit and score.py does not surface per-criterion errors (lesson 11; budget sufficiency belongs to row 11).
